evidence.summary: Module docstring (quoted: 'illustrative') describes a deals pipeline with custom stages and email reminders for stale deals.
DEFAULT_STAGES is new, contacted, negotiating, closed.
move_deal(db, deal_id, stage, stages=DEFAULT_STAGES) raises ValueError('unknown stage') for a stage not in the given list, otherwise updates stage and sets moved_at to datetime.utcnow().
stale_deal_reminders(db, mailer, days=14) selects deals with moved_at older than the cutoff and sends one email per deal to deal['owner_email'] naming the deal title and the day count.

backend: Python (plain functions; db and mailer injected by the caller)
database: unspecified; accessed through an injected db object

runtimes.python: version not pinned; uses datetime and timedelta from the standard library

architecture.backend: A single Python module whose functions take the database and mailer as parameters (dependency injection); no HTTP layer or scheduler.

features.name: Deals pipeline (custom stages)
features.description: Move deals through a stage list the caller supplies (default new, contacted, negotiating, closed), recording when each deal last moved.
features.observed_behaviour: move_deal validates the stage against the supplied list, raises ValueError('unknown stage') otherwise, and writes stage plus moved_at (UTC now).
features.business_logic: Stage list is a parameter, so stages are customisable per call; any stage may move to any other; moved_at is set on every move.
features.integration: Needs persistence and somewhere to store each pipeline's custom stage list (not present in the source).

features.name: Stale-deal email reminders
features.description: Email each deal's owner when the deal has not moved for a number of days (default 14).
features.observed_behaviour: stale_deal_reminders selects deals with moved_at earlier than now minus days and calls mailer.send(owner_email, message) once per deal.
features.business_logic: Threshold default 14 days; one email per stale deal per run; no de-duplication between runs is visible; closed deals are not excluded.
features.integration: Needs an email provider and a scheduler (neither is in the source).

integrations.name: Email (injected mailer)
integrations.purpose: send stale-deal reminders to deal owners

error_handling.case: move a deal to a stage not in the list

unknowns: Deal schema: there is no schema file; fields are inferred from how the code uses them (title, stage, moved_at, owner_email) and the primary key type is unknown.
Where custom stage lists are stored or configured: the code takes them as a parameter only.
Owners and authentication: deals carry an owner_email, but there is no user, auth or role code.
Scheduling and email provider: how stale_deal_reminders is triggered and which mailer is used are not in the source.
Contacts: DealFlow has no contact entity; whether deals link to contacts is unknown.
